findings: Evidence on OQ-24 (benzecri1960_ch1.tex:246–253): Déf. 8's SECOND sentence (the segment form, unambiguous) is proved equivalent to the FIRST in the ∪ reading (isConvexPart_iff_isSegConvex, no hypothesis on E), and contradicted by the Minkowski reading on S(E) itself (isSegConvex_univ vs not_isConvexPartMinkowski_univ) and on every nonzero linear subvariety (isConvexPart_linearSubvariety vs not_isConvexPartMinkowski_linearSubvariety).
